---
title: Blog
format:
  html:
    page-layout: article      # full: The content fills all space in the page
title-block-banner: true   # A big "blog" banner is displayed in the listing page
listing:
  contents: .
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories]  # objects to be put on the list
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: numbered     # 右側顯示分類 + 篇數，且可點擊篩選
  page-size: 10            # 10 articles per page
  sort-ui: false
---
